summary: Validated new partial payment (pendente) flow for Contas a Pagar e Contas a Receber via UI. Partial no longer counts until manually confirmed. Confirmar/Reverter cycle works. Quitar Total ainda quita imediatamente.

issues: Hydration warning: <span data-ve-dynamic> wrapper is being rendered as child of <tbody> and <tr>, breaking HTML validity. Coming from Emergent editor overlay (x-excluded=true). Non-blocking but produces console errors.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate stale valor_pago local state after Reverter: when user Reverts a paid entry and immediately clicks 'Quitar Total' in the same page, the pre-fill uses stale saldo (previous confirmed value), causing full quitação to be short. Reproduce: partial 300 -> confirmar -> reverter -> open quitar modal -> Quitar Total -> only R$700 was pago in a R$1000 conta. Refreshing the account state after confirmarPagamento/Reverter, or recomputing saldo from server response, resolves it. Not a blocker but user-facing subtlety.
critical_code_review_comments: ContasPagarPage.jsx state after confirmarPagamento/Reverter may not refresh quitarContaInfo.valor_pago, causing stale saldo pre-fill on subsequent Quitar Total.
Hydration errors due to editor wrapper spans inside tbody/tr — cosmetic only in preview env.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned 2x contas-pagar + 1x contas-receber prefixed TEST_
context_for_next_testing_agent: All partial-payment flows verified end-to-end via UI: badge testids pagamento-status-<id>/recebimento-status-<id>, btn-confirmar-pagamento-<id>/btn-confirmar-recebimento-<id>, btn-reverter-pagamento-<id>/btn-reverter-recebimento-<id>. Toasts confirm pendente / confirmado / revertido. Full 'Quitar Total' still marks Quitada instantly.
